# FDG2026

> DO use exception messages to communicate framework usage mistakes to the developer.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 2.2.3.2 Exceptions.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: whether a message names the usage mistake is judgment. Chapter 7 gives the detailed exception message rules.

## From the book

For example, if a user forgets to set the `Source` property on an `EventLog` component, any calls to a method that requires the source to be set should state this clearly in the exception message. Chapter 7 provides more guidance about the design of exceptions and exception messages.
